note: Under "e2e", the tests each spec file of tests/e2e holds, which npm run check:test-results compares with the run's report. Under "layout", the same for the stackless checks of tests/playwright.layout.config.ts that the quality job runs (npm run check:test-results -- --counts layout). Under "vitest", the floor of tests each Vitest project holds when every one of its files runs, which scripts/vitest-results-reporter.ts checks (U-15); "api-integration" is the API's own runner of its integration tests (apps/api/vitest.config.ts). Change a count in the same change that adds, deletes or splits a test; raise a floor when a project grows.
